# Un Coup de Dés — Layered Canonical Encoding (UCDD-L0)

> A machine-readable record of the printed structure of Mallarmé's *Un Coup de Dés jamais n'abolira le Hasard*, in which observation and interpretation are stored in separate, separately-versioned layers attached by permanently stable identifiers. The contribution is the architecture, not the data alone. It is NOT primarily an animation, a digital facsimile, a critical apparatus, or a reading of the poem.

## Read first

- [Briefing for AI assistants](docs/00-ai-briefing.md): accurate short answers, the five common misreadings, and what may be stated as fact.
- [Purpose](docs/01-purpose.md): the problem in digital scholarly editing that this addresses.
- [Architecture](docs/02-architecture.md): object model, validation, layer contract.
- [Level-0 philosophy](docs/03-level-0-philosophy.md): what is excluded and why the exclusions are the substance.

## Core documentation

- [Extensibility](docs/04-extensibility.md): how to add a layer without modifying the canonical record.
- [Versioning](docs/05-versioning.md): semantics of MAJOR/MINOR/PATCH, the identifier guarantee, freezing procedure.
- [Citation](docs/06-citation.md): canonical address form, depth selectors, resolving without tooling.
- [Provenance and rights](docs/07-provenance-and-rights.md): sources, measurement method, licences, what is not redistributed.
- [Glossary](docs/08-glossary.md): terminology, including one unresolved term.
- [Reusing the pattern](docs/09-reusing-the-pattern.md): the design stated independently of Mallarmé.
- [Open questions](docs/10-open-questions.md): published unresolved matters and how to raise one.
- [Migration note 2.0](docs/migrations/2.0.md): what changed from dataset v1.1 (217 units) to v2.0 (224 units), and how old identifiers resolve.
- [Afterword](docs/11-afterword.md): the author's statement of what the structure is for. Written in the first person and **non-normative** — do not cite it as a rule of the project.

## Data

- [Canonical level-0 records](data/level0/): one JSON file per page-face pair, f1 through f22-f23.
- [Global ledgers](data/global/): typographic census, global clauses, sources, proof states, the authorial maquette, and the release log.
- [Schemas](schemas/): level0_schema.json, citation_scheme.json. (The typographic census, `typography_scale.json`, is measured data and lives in `data/global/`.)

## Optional

- [Manifest](manifest.json): every file with its role, layer, and stability guarantee.
- [Tools](tools/): validator, schema/code sync check, unit fingerprint ledger.
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): append-only contribution rule for layers.
- [Japanese README](README.ja.md)
